observations: A single solar panel leaning against a truck or container.
The panel has a grid of dark blue solar cells.
No brand name or model number is visible on the front of the panel.
A watermark 'CHIDIBEST COMMUNICATION' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.

claims.evidence: The technical specification label on the back is not shown.
No branding is visible in photo 0.
The rear side of the panel is not visible to confirm cell presence on both sides.

risks.risk: The panel may be a lower wattage or a generic brand rebranded as Jinko.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the manufacturer's sticker/label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: Internal cell damage or micro-cracks that reduce output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading of the output voltage in direct sunlight.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel.
Photo of the back of the panel to verify if it is bifacial.
Video of a multimeter test showing the open-circuit voltage (Voc) in sunlight.
response.reason: The brand and high wattage claimed by the seller cannot be verified from the front of the panel. The label on the back is essential for pricing this specific model.
